notes.title: TwinForce - new VR Content (Update 07.7_20160926_2233)
notes.content:
New VR Content :

- VR world scale option : change the proportions of the game
- VR game bezel option : show/hide an arcade inspired artwork around the game area
- Added LED matrix visual surrounding for VR Mode

Also the launch crash wasn't totally solved previously, and should be gone for good with this update.

notes.title: TwinForce - Leaderboard restored (Update 07.7_20160924_2104)
notes.content:
Launch issues should have been solved.

[u]If you still have problems to launch the game, please uninstall then reinstall it by following these steps : [/u]
- Make sure that the game is fully closed
- In your library, right-click on TwinForce, then 'Delete local content...' and delete
- When it's done, reinstall the game by right-clicking on Twinforce, 'Install game...'

tags.bug: Launch issues should have been solved.
